discovery: Discovery of GLP-1 and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology led to drugs with very large clinical and public-health impact in type 2 diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular risk reduction. The work has been recognized by the 2024 Lasker Award and the 2024 Breakthrough Prize, has matured over decades, and is now widely seen as a leading Nobel candidate.
